name: aasb-aas-data-analytics
description: Install the "AAS Data Analytics & Business Intelligence" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Business intelligence, metric definitions and analytical evidence.
interface.longDescription: Business intelligence, metric definitions and analytical evidence. Validate business metrics and data, analyze SQL and experiments, and explain dashboards, market sizing and financial models with traceable assumptions. Recommended for: Product analysts, Data-informed product teams, Founders measuring funnels. Not for: Production ingestion and orchestration: use Data Engineering Platform, Creating evidence when source data or definitions are unavailable. Covers Analytics Tracking, Analytics Product, and 14 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the supplied dataset and business question. Check missing values, duplicates, join cardinality and metric definitions before writing SQL or building a dashboard. Deliver the analysis, validation results and decision limits; propose tracking only if the task requires it.
Use this plugin to review this SQL model and propose safer metrics and joins.
Use this plugin to design an A/B test and the KPI dashboard needed to read it.

Review this project for the added coverage: Review analytical query performance without changing metric semantics; Explain verified analytical results with context, uncertainty and clear visuals. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
